entities.name: Gururaja Poojary
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gururaja Poojary, also known as P. Gururaja, is an Indian weightlifter who won the silver medal in the men's 56 kg weight class at the 2018 Commonwealth Games and the bronze medal in 61 kg weight class at the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
